static_traits.name: Lin Shan
static_traits.family_status: Living with parents and a dog
static_traits.social_status: Strong family support, close relationship with the dog, but does not discuss inferiority feelings with family; Interpersonal relationships not yet visibly affected
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no psychotherapy received in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good cooperation, negative tone, frequent Self-denial and catastrophizing expressions; Skeptical attitude toward change

basic_info.main_problem: I really want to own a Porsche, but I always believe I can never achieve it, because I can never earn enough money. This belief makes me feel despair and not good enough.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I noticed these feelings of inferiority and despair are affecting my daily motivation and academic performance.
growth_experiences: A few years ago began paying more attention to luxury cars and wealth; after entering university, seeing peers pursue high-paying careers sparked comparison with others, gradually forming the belief 'I can never earn a good income'; whenever seeing luxury cars or hearing stories of successful people, inferiority and despair are triggered.

After graduation, job applications for marketing positions have yielded no results; self-evaluation rapidly declined, seeing myself as a failure; unable to visit family who live far away for financial reasons; when seeing friends' Family gatherings on social media, strongly experiencing Loneliness and feelings of worthlessness.

core_beliefs: I can never earn a good income
I am not good enough / a failure

special_situations.event: Sees luxury cars (such as a Porsche) on the street or online
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot earn enough money to own a luxury car, it means I am a failure and have no worth
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding related information, negating my own efforts, staying in bed without acting to reduce Sense of frustration
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never afford a Porsche; I cannot possibly earn a good income

special_situations.event: Hears or sees news of successful people / peers pursuing high-paying careers
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am not as successful as them, it proves I am not capable and not good enough
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Not discussing feelings with family, reducing job-seeking and Learning actions to avoid feeling like a failure again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not as good as others, will never succeed

special_situations.event: Seeing Family gatherings posted by friends on social media
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot afford to visit family, it means I am an unfilial / useless person
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lies in bed, reduces interaction with others, and avoids scenes that trigger shame
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I can never afford to visit family; I am a failure

special_situations.event: Continued job-seeking with no results yet (applied for marketing positions but have not received an offer yet)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot find Work now, it means there will be no change in the future either
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing the frequency of action, questioning the effectiveness of any plan, remaining skeptical to avoid disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I may never find Work; this will not change anything

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a capable person, achieve wealth and success, and maintain closeness and connection with family
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being seen as a failure or useless, worrying that effort still cannot change reality, and being judged by others (including family and peers)
defense_goal: Lowers expectations and avoids action to reduce the shame and pain of failure
Staying distant and not showing feelings to avoid hurt from external judgment

object_relations.object_representation: Successful people/peers are superior, out-of-reach others who may bring comparison and judgment

object_relations.self_representation: An outsider who wants closeness but is powerless
object_relations.object_representation: Family members are warm but financially hard-to-reach objects (distance and cost become barriers)

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes positive reframing and formulating concrete, executable small goals (such as updating the resume, applying for positions)
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to believe these methods will not work for them, feeling 'I am doomed to fail', thus negating the possibility of change
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using a negative, skeptical tone, repeating 'this may be useless / not very realistic', deflecting with the 'maybe, but...' construction; verbally reluctantly agreeing to try, but not expressing emotional investment or expectations.

manifestations: Feeling despair and not good enough, seeing effort as Meaninglessness
Daily Decreased drive and Academic performance affected
Losing confidence in the future after job-seeking setbacks
outcomes: Emptiness about life goals and values

manifestations: Experiencing intense Loneliness and feelings of worthlessness when seeing friends' Family gatherings
Not discussing inner feelings with family, maintaining emotional distance

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent self-blame and Self-denial ('I am a failure')
Strongly skeptical about change; hard to allow self to try
Over-focusing on own inadequacy, overlooking existing abilities and resources (degree, marketing skill)

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves, corresponding to 'impulse'.
manifestations: Not expressing true feelings to family, turning the need for connection into self-depletion
Lying in bed without acting when negative emotions strike
Gives up seeking support, instead endures and torments oneself

positive_force: Has a degree and some marketing skill, with a career foundation to build on
The family is overall fairly supportive, relationship with the pet is close, with emotional comfort resources
negative_force: Catastrophizing predictions and overgeneralization, habitually jumping to the worst conclusion
Personalization and comparison tendencies causing persistent inferiority
Insufficient motivation and avoidant behavior (lying in bed for long periods, reduced activity)
Not discussing feelings with family; emotional distance intensifying Loneliness
Sleep disturbance, further weakening energy and executive function

target_behavior.behavior: When negative emotions strike, lies in bed for long periods and reduces job-seeking and study actions
antecedent: Seeing information about luxury cars or successful people
Seeing friends' Family gatherings on social media
Experiencing intense guilt and feelings of worthlessness upon waking
Feedback of continued job-seeking with no results yet
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic predictions about the future and the core belief 'I am a failure' lead to feelings of powerlessness and avoidant tendencies
target_behavior.function: Avoiding failure and Anxiety, temporarily easing shame and stress
target_behavior.consequence: Academic and job-seeking progress is blocked, motivation declines further, maintaining the vicious cycle of negative beliefs

antecedent: Repeatedly thinking about inferiority and hopelessness at night
Persistent negative comparisons and worries during the day
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent anxiety and negative automatic thoughts disrupting physiological rhythms
target_behavior.function: Trying to escape stress through sleep/rest but actually reinforcing fatigue and inefficiency
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient daytime energy, decreased drive for action, worsening academic and job-seeking impairment
